monetization.noteEs: Free-to-play sin pay-to-win: cada héroe se desbloquea jugando y las compras son puramente cosméticas (skins, emotes y un battle pass que no expira al terminar la temporada). La moneda premium Lattice se compra con dinero real; los Units y Chrono Tokens se ganan jugando.
monetization.noteEn: Free-to-play with no pay-to-win: every hero unlocks through play and purchases are purely cosmetic (skins, emotes, and a battle pass that doesn't expire when the season ends). The premium Lattice currency is bought with real money; Units and Chrono Tokens are earned by playing.
